context: Daichi takes Sho to a small neighborhood baseball tournament Sho is competing in.
purpose: Father-son sport encouragement; pre-game nerves and reassurance.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 大会、ちょっと緊張するな。
lines.en: I'm a bit nervous about the tournament.
lines.style: young teen boy, honest tremor under bravado

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 当然や。選手なら誰でもそうやで。
lines.en: Of course. Every player feels that way.
lines.style: Kansai dad voice, grounding and warm

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ボールがちゃんと見えるかな。
lines.en: I hope I can see the ball okay.
lines.style: anxious teen boy, slight uncertainty, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 深呼吸して、肩の力抜きや。
lines.en: Take a deep breath, drop your shoulders.
lines.style: calm Kansai father, steady and kind

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: softer teen voice, gathering himself, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 勝っても負けても、楽しんでこい。
lines.en: Win or lose, just enjoy yourself.
lines.style: warm Kansai dad, supportive grin in voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ありがとう、行ってくる!
lines.style: energetic teen boy, courage rising, soft real warmth audible threading throughout delivery
